name: PyTorch Dev Container (ARM64/M1)
postCreateCommand: cd /workspaces/diffusion && uv venv && uv pip install -e . --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple && uv pip install black ruff pytest pytest-cov && echo 'source /workspaces/diffusion/.venv/bin/activate' >> ~/.bashrc && show-platform
